messages:
sam: Hey team — planning a short trip to Amsterdam 6/10-6/13 for customer visits. Question about per-diem and booking: corporate card is on a different billing cycle so i have to use personal card for hotel. Can I get an advance to cover hotel + meals?

maria - People Ops: Hi @sam :wave: yes, you can request a travel advance. We typically allow up to 50% of the total estimated trip cost in advance (exceptions possible with manager + People Ops approval). For hotel on a personal card we ask that you: 1) upload the hotel estimate and itinerary to the Travel form, 2) tag the expense with cost center, and 3) indicate whether you want the advance to cover lodging.

sam: Cool — do i still need meal receipts if i take per-diem? Also what counts as "meal" vs "entertainment" for client dinners?

maria - People Ops: Per-diem covers personal meals up to the daily cap, so you don't need to submit meal receipts for those. For client dinners, use the expense type "Meals - Client Entertainment" and attach the itemized receipt plus names and company of attendees (per compliance). If meal includes alcohol, note it on the receipt upload.

leo (Finance): adding a couple finance notes: If you book on personal card, please upload the actual card statement line and hotel folio where possible. We require receipts for lodging, transportation, and client meals. Public transit receipts (train, tram) are not required for per-diem but are required for reimbursement if you claim actuals. Missing receipt policy: under $75 we accept a signed missing receipt memo; over $75 requires vendor outreach.

travel-bot: Automated reminder: Complete Travel form and attach itinerary to trigger advance approval workflow. Missing manager approval will pause processing.

sam: how long does the advance usually take? flight is already booked and I don't want to front the hotel for too long.

maria - People Ops: Standard is 3 business days after approvals clear. If you need it sooner, select "Expedite" on the form and cc your manager; we'll escalate to Finance queue. Also indicate the date you need funds by.

natalie: fwiw, when i did Dublin last quarter, i requested 50% for lodging and got it in 2 business days after my manager approved. Finance netted the advance against my final reimbursement. Make sure to note the advance amount in Ramp expense notes.

sam: great — i'll fill out the Travel form now and tag @maria if anything else comes up. Thanks! :thumbsup:
